messages.author: 19beac2918fdc8d9
messages.subject: INLA Segmentation fault
parts:
Hi, I installed INLA using the command line install.packages(“INLA”, repos=“http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/R/stable“). 

However, after installation I checked the directory /home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit, it says "Segmentation fault"

$ pwd
/home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit
$ ls
Segmentation fault

When I run another program which uses INLA, it gives me the following error:
/home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla: /usr/lib64/libgfortran.so.3: version `GFORTRAN_1.4' not found (required by /home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla)
/home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla: /usr/lib64/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.15' not found (required by /home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla)
/home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla: /lib64/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.14' not found (required by /home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla)
/home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla: /lib64/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.14' not found (required by /home/user/R/3.3.2-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/libgsl.so.19)

I am not sure whether these errors are caused by the segmentation fault, or failing to find the libraries? Anyone has any idea? How to solve the Segmentation fault problem?

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA Segmentation fault
parts:
On Mon, 2017-05-22 at 17:53 -0700, Hong Zheng wrote:
> Hi, I installed INLA using the command line install.packages(“INLA”,
> repos=“http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/R/stable“). 
>

you can do (unless you use 'rgeneric') do

library(INLA)
INLA:::inla.dynload.workaround()

otherwise, do

inla.update(testing=TRUE)

restart R and retry.



--
Håvard Rue <hr...@r-inla.org>
r-inla.org
